author: HitByADagger
body:
G'day

IGN:  HitByADagger


I got banned for "Ddos Threats" by "Jiveh" on the server.

But I said that "I was going to get a booter" not meaning that i was going to Ddos someone.

If I did make you scared for some reason, I am really sorry and I apologize if so.

I've have been waiting a week for a response but no one responded yet so please.
So please reconsider the mistake, I have been so I apologize once again for my mistakes.

Please un-ban me.

replies.body:

Usually in the past we don't appeal bans if you decide to ban evade after :)
